pictures.scene: Jean-Leon Gerome, Solomon's Wall, Jerusalem — an enormous sunlit wall of ancient ashlar blocks filling the whole picture with tufts of hyssop growing out of the joints, and men at prayer along its foot, one bowed right against the stone in a white robe, one standing on the flagstones in a long coat and a fur hat with his back to us, one afternoon peter and john were going up to the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour, and a man who was lame from birth was being carried to the temple gate called beautiful, where he was put every day to beg from those entering the temple courts
pictures.name: pd_gerome_wall

pictures.scene: Jules Bastien-Lepage, The Beggar — an old man in a worn grey coat and a shapeless cap leaning in a doorway with his stick and his sack, his hand held out and his face patient, and a little girl in a blue pinafore watching him from behind the open door, when he saw peter and john about to enter, he asked them for money, peter looked directly at him, as did john, look at us, said peter
pictures.name: pd_bastien_mendiant

pictures.scene: Quentin Metsys, Salvator Mundi — Christ close up and facing us, dark hair falling to His shoulders and a short beard, a gold rayed nimbus behind His head, a crimson robe with worked gold embroidery and a jewelled clasp at the breast, His right hand raised with two fingers lifted to bless, so the man gave them his attention, expecting to receive something from them, but peter said, silver or gold i do not have, but what i have i give you, in the name of jesus christ of nazareth, get up and walk
pictures.name: pd_metsys_salvator_mundi

pictures.scene: Manner of Adam van Noort, Saints Peter and John Healing the Lame Man — the lame man sitting on the chequered pavement with his crutches and his begging basket beside him, his head bound in a cloth and turned up, reaching out his hand to Peter who bends down to him in a red cloak and takes hold of him, John standing behind in red with a pale mantle, and onlookers in the shadow of the colonnade, taking him by the right hand, peter helped him up, and at once the man's feet and ankles were made strong, he sprang to his feet and began to walk, walking and leaping and praising god
pictures.name: pd_lame_man

pictures.scene: Masaccio, Saint Peter Healing the Sick with his Shadow — Peter walking down a narrow Florentine street in a great yellow cloak with his face set straight ahead, John following behind him in rose, a bald old beggar sitting against the wall with his arms folded and his cloak slipping from his shoulder, and a crippled man on his knees in the street with wooden blocks strapped to his hands, townsmen watching from the doorways, when all the people saw him walking and praising god, they recognized him as the man who used to sit begging at the beautiful gate of the temple, and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him
pictures.name: pd_masaccio_schaduw

pictures.scene: Raphael, Saint Paul Preaching at Athens — the apostle standing up on the steps with both hands lifted and his head thrown back as he speaks, a green tunic under a rose mantle and a thin ring of light at his head, the crowd seated on the steps below him and standing in close among great columns, every face turned toward him, while the man clung to peter and john, all the people were astonished and ran to them in the walkway called solomon's colonnade, and peter said, men of israel, why do you stare at us as if by our own power or godliness we had made this man walk
pictures.name: pd_raphael_saint_paul_preaching_at_athens

pictures.scene: Nikolai Ge, What Is Truth — Pilate standing in a band of hard sunlight in a gold toga with his hand flung out as he asks it, and Christ in a dark red robe back in the shadow against an ochre wall, His hands bound, His head bowed, His feet bare, a long bar of sunlight lying across the stone floor between the two of them, the god of abraham, isaac, and jacob, the god of our fathers, has glorified his servant jesus, you handed him over and rejected him before pilate, and asked that a murderer be released to you
pictures.name: pd_ge_what_is_truth

pictures.scene: Annibale Carracci, The Holy Women at the Tomb — two women turning away from the opened tomb, one in a blue mantle over red with her hand thrown up in the air, the other bending forward in a white grey mantle with her hand reaching out before her, a third in yellow and red at the edge of the picture, and the empty stone behind them, you killed the author of life, but god raised him from the dead, and we are witnesses of the fact, by faith in the name of jesus, this man whom you see and know has been made strong
pictures.name: pd_carracci_holy_women_at_the_tomb

pictures.scene: Hans Memling, Christ as the Man of Sorrows — Christ against a dark ground with the plaited crown of thorns pressed down on His head and the blood running from His brow into His hair, fine gold rays springing out all round, His long dark hair falling over a deep red robe, His right hand lifted to show the wound through the palm, and now, brothers, i know that you acted in ignorance, as did your leaders, but in this way god has fulfilled what he foretold through all the prophets, saying that his christ would suffer
pictures.name: pd_memling_man_of_sorrows

pictures.scene: El Greco, The Repentant Saint Peter — the old apostle standing under a trail of green ivy with his hands clasped tight together and his face lifted into the light, his eyes wet and his mouth open, a great gold mantle over a pale blue green robe and the two keys hanging at his side, repent, then, and turn back, so that your sins may be wiped away, that times of refreshing may come from the presence of the lord, and that he may send jesus, the christ, who has been appointed for you
pictures.name: pd_el_greco_the_repentant_saint_peter

pictures.scene: Philippe de Champaigne, Moses with the Ten Commandments — Moses looking straight out at us with two horns of light springing from his white hair, a long grey beard spread over his breast, a deep blue mantle over a gold embroidered robe, and the written tablet of the law held upright against his shoulder with his hand laid along the bottom of it, heaven must take him in until the time comes for the restoration of all things, for moses said, the lord your god will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers, you must listen to him in everything he tells you
pictures.name: pd_champaigne_moses_with_the_ten_commandments

pictures.scene: Claude Lorrain, David Anointed King by the Prophet Samuel — the old prophet in a blue robe and a red mantle reaching up to pour the horn of oil over the head of the young shepherd, who stands before him in a plain dark tunic with his staff in his hand and his head bowed under it, a boy and a man waiting behind them in the shadow of the pillars, everyone who does not listen to him will be completely cut off from among his people, indeed, all the prophets from samuel on, as many as have spoken, have proclaimed these days
pictures.name: pd_lorrain_gezalfd

pictures.scene: Jacob Willemsz de Wet, Christ Blessing the Children — Christ seated on the steps in a pale robe with a soft ring of light about His head, His head inclined and His hand laid on His breast, and the children brought close in to Him on every side, a girl kneeling before Him with her hands joined, a small boy at His knee looking up, mothers kneeling with babies in their arms, a little one in a red cap sitting down on the stone in front, and you are sons of the prophets and of the covenant god made with your fathers when he said to abraham, through your offspring all the families of the earth will be blessed, when god raised up his servant, he sent him first to you to bless you by turning each of you from your wicked ways
pictures.name: pd_dewet_christus_zegent_kinderen

lines.text: One afternoon Peter and John were going up to the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.
And a man who was lame from birth was being carried to the temple gate called Beautiful, where he was put every day to beg from those entering the temple courts.
When he saw Peter and John about to enter, he asked them for money.
Peter looked directly at him, as did John. Look at us! said Peter.
So the man gave them his attention, expecting to receive something from them.
But Peter said, Silver or gold I do not have, but what I have I give you: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!
Taking him by the right hand, Peter helped him up, and at once the man's feet and ankles were made strong.
He sprang to his feet and began to walk. Then he went with them into the temple courts, walking and leaping and praising God.
When all the people saw him walking and praising God,
they recognized him as the man who used to sit begging at the Beautiful Gate of the temple, and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.
While the man clung to Peter and John, all the people were astonished and ran to them in the walkway called Solomon's Colonnade.
And when Peter saw this, he addressed the people: Men of Israel, why are you surprised by this? Why do you stare at us as if by our own power or godliness we had made this man walk?
The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified His servant Jesus. You handed Him over and rejected Him before Pilate, even though he had decided to release Him.
You rejected the Holy and Righteous One and asked that a murderer be released to you.
You killed the Author of life, but God raised Him from the dead, and we are witnesses of the fact.
By faith in the name of Jesus, this man whom you see and know has been made strong. It is Jesus' name and the faith that comes through Him that has given him this complete healing in your presence.
And now, brothers, I know that you acted in ignorance, as did your leaders.
But in this way God has fulfilled what He foretold through all the prophets, saying that His Christ would suffer.
Repent, then, and turn back, so that your sins may be wiped away,
that times of refreshing may come from the presence of the Lord, and that He may send Jesus, the Christ, who has been appointed for you.
Heaven must take Him in until the time comes for the restoration of all things, which God announced long ago through His holy prophets.
For Moses said, The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers. You must listen to Him in everything He tells you.
Everyone who does not listen to Him will be completely cut off from among his people.
Indeed, all the prophets from Samuel on, as many as have spoken, have proclaimed these days.
And you are sons of the prophets and of the covenant God made with your fathers when He said to Abraham, Through your offspring all the families of the earth will be blessed.
When God raised up His Servant, He sent Him first to you to bless you by turning each of you from your wicked ways.
